workforce.title: Workforce analytics
workforce.purpose: Aggregate workforce, pipeline, training and critical-role depth. Groups under 10 are suppressed.

workforce-emiratization.title: Emiratization
workforce-emiratization.purpose: Emiratization by entity, job family and level, with definitions and reconciliation notes.

workforce-critical-roles.title: Critical roles
workforce-critical-roles.purpose: Bench depth for licensed and scarce roles against targets: counts only, never names.

workforce-scenarios.title: Scenario planner
workforce-scenarios.purpose: Headcount scenarios by technology or programme, always labelled SIMULATED.

workforce-definitions.title: Metric definitions
workforce-definitions.purpose: Definition, GRI disclosure, source table and public source for every workforce metric.

observer.title: Observer reports
observer.purpose: Aggregate reports that ENEC has approved for release to your organisation. Not a regulatory channel.

noData: No aggregate data for this selection.
sampleNote: Synthetic aggregates for the demo tenant. Any group under {n} people shows "suppressed", never a value.

metric.jpm_to_signed_days: Days from JPM to signed record

def.emiratization: UAE nationals as a share of all employees of ENEC, ENEC Operations and ENEC Commercial at year end.
def.emiratization_senior: UAE nationals as a share of employees in senior management positions.
def.top_positions_uae: Number of UAE nationals holding top positions, as published in the sustainability report.
def.women: Women as a share of all employees at year end.
def.employees: Total employees of the group at year end.
def.training_hours: Total hours of training delivered to employees in the year.
def.training_hours_per_employee: Training hours divided by the number of employees.
def.attrition: Employees who left as a share of employees. The published chart is hard to read, so the year mapping is uncertain.
def.hires: New employees hired in the year. Read from a chart; treat as approximate.
def.sro_ro: Senior Reactor Operators and Reactor Operators holding a FANR operator certificate, as stated in ENEC's GPO release.
def.coct_population: Licensed operators in the continuing operator training programme.
def.loct_population: Local operators in the local operator continuing training programme.
def.quals_renewed_on_time: Share of qualifications renewed before their expiry date in the quarter (demo tenant).
def.lapses: Number of licence validity lapses detected in the quarter (demo tenant).
def.jpm_to_signed_days: Average days between a JPM being performed and the record being signed (demo tenant).
def.equivalency_turnaround: Average days from a contractor equivalency request to the decision (demo tenant).
def.share_emirati: Emirati employees divided by headcount for the selected group and quarter.
def.share_women: Women divided by headcount for the selected group and quarter.
def.headcount: Employees on the last day of the quarter.
def.attrition_rate: Employees who left during the quarter.
def.hours_per_head: Training hours recorded in the quarter divided by headcount.
def.bench_depth: For each critical role: people qualified now, people in training, people in the pipeline, against a target set by HR. Counts only.
def.cohort_progress: Scholar and intern cohorts from intake to study, graduation and placement. Cohorts under the minimum group size are suppressed.
def.completions: Completed training records per course. Courses with fewer than the minimum group size are suppressed.
def.funnel: Applications currently at each stage, by programme. Cells under the minimum group size are suppressed.

reconcile.title: Why do public figures differ?
reconcile.body: Press releases and the ENEC Operations CEO message say "around 60%" of about 3,000 staff are Emirati. Audited GRI data for the whole group gives 54.7% for 2024 (2,979 employees; 1,581 UAE nationals, which is 53.1%). Use the GRI figure when precision matters.

overview.intro: An accurate, aggregate view of workforce composition, pipeline health, training volume and critical-role depth. Nothing on these pages ranks or names individuals.
overview.publicHint: From ENEC's 2024 sustainability report (GRI data). Each tile links to its definition and source.
overview.trendNote: Group-level GRI values. The 2024 Emiratization column is labelled 2023 twice in the source chart.

emiratization.title: Emiratization
emiratization.body: By entity, job family and level, with suppression.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.body: From programme intake to placement and the operator ladder.

critical-roles.title: Critical roles
critical-roles.body: Bench depth against HR targets. Counts only.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.body: Every metric, its source table and GRI disclosure.

releases.title: Releases to observers
releases.hint: HR prepares an aggregate report; the named HR authority (CHCO office) approves the release. Every step is audited.
releases.makerChecker: The preparer cannot approve their own release.
releases.rule: Maker-checker: the person who prepared a report cannot approve it. Observers see a report only after approval and only if it is released to their organisation.

confirmBody.submit: "{title}" goes to the CHCO office for approval, with the organisations selected below.
confirmBody.approve: "{title}" becomes visible to the selected observer organisations. The approval is recorded with your role.
confirmBody.withdraw: "{title}" stops being visible to observers. The withdrawal is recorded.

releases.emptyBody: This report has no tiles yet.
releases.draftHint: Choose published, organisation-level indicators. Values are copied from the KPI series with their source; nothing below the minimum group size can be added.

em.intro: Emiratization and women's share by entity, job family and level. Aggregate only: any group under the minimum size is suppressed.
em.publicHint: GRI 405-1 values from the 2024 sustainability report.
em.breakdownHint: Choose a dimension and, if you like, a single group. Groups under {n} people show "suppressed".
em.suppressedGroupsSub: Fewer than {n} people: no value shown

how.emirati: Emirati employees divided by headcount for each group. If either number belongs to a group under the minimum size, the share is suppressed.
how.women: Women divided by headcount for each group. If either number belongs to a group under the minimum size, the share is suppressed.

pipe.intro: From programme intake to placement, in aggregate: published programme facts, scholar cohorts and the licensed operator ladder.
pipe.programmesHint: Public facts per programme, each with its source.
pipe.funnelBody: Counts of applications by programme and stage are on the funnel page, with small cells suppressed.
pipe.cohortsHint: Cohorts under {n} people are suppressed and left out of the totals.
pipe.excluded: {n} small cohorts suppressed and excluded from the totals.
pipe.operatorHint: Local Operator to Reactor Operator to Senior Reactor Operator to Shift Supervisor, in counts.
pipe.ladderNote: Bars show people qualified against the HR target. FANR certifies ROs and SROs; Kafa'a mirrors the licensee's records.
pipe.nexusHint: Read-only view of NEXUS cohort qualification progress. Headcounts under 10 are suppressed.
pipe.noNexus: No NEXUS cohort data is available to your role.
pipe.nexusNote: Progress percentages per cohort and qualification; no individual records.

cr.intro: Bench depth for licensed and scarce roles: people qualified, in training and in the pipeline, against a target set by HR.
cr.countsBody: Succession is shown as counts by role, never as names on a chart. No individual is ranked or scored.
cr.chartNote: The vertical mark is the HR target. Green: target met; amber: 90% or more; red: below 90%.
cr.setTargetBody: The new target applies to this quarter's bench-depth view. Give the reason; it is kept in the audit log.
cr.reasonHint: For example: fifth crew planned, outage season, new unit timeline.

tr.intro: Training volume in aggregate: published hours, continuing-training populations, hours per head by job family and completions by course.
tr.publicHint: GRI 404-1 values and continuing-training populations from the 2024 sustainability report.
tr.tenantHint: By job family and quarter. Families under {n} people are suppressed.
tr.perFamily: Hours per head by job family, {period}
tr.quarterTrend: Organisation hours per head by quarter
tr.completionsHint: Completed training records per course. Courses with fewer than {n} completions are suppressed.
tr.noCompletions: No completion records are visible to your role.
tr.noCompletionsBody: Completions come from the training records system through the learning module.
tr.qualityHint: Internal indicators for the demo tenant.

sc.intro: Explore how many licensed operators a programme or technology choice might need. Every number here is SIMULATED from the assumptions you enter.
sc.simBody: This planner multiplies your assumptions. It does not predict ENEC decisions, and ENEC is evaluating new technologies without any deployment decision implied.
sc.techHint: Label only: the staffing per unit below is your assumption.
sc.fixInputs: Correct the highlighted assumptions to see results.
sc.method: Method: current candidates license over three years; DNT graduates reach RO about five years after intake and half progress; attrition applies every year. Baseline 190 licensed operators (ENEC GPO release, Aug 2025).
sc.name: Name
sc.nameHint: "(SIMULATED)" is added to the name automatically.

obs.intro: Aggregate reports that ENEC's HR authority has approved for release to your organisation.
obs.notRegBody: These reports are aggregate, approved and released by ENEC. Regulatory reporting continues through the official channels between the licensee and FANR.
obs.auditorNote: Auditor view: you see every report, including drafts and withdrawn releases, read-only.
obs.none: No reports have been released to your organisation
obs.noneBody: A report appears here only after the CHCO office approves its release to your organisation.
obs.approvedOn: Approved for release on {date} by the CHCO office.

defs.intro: Every tile on the workforce pages links here. Each entry gives the definition, the unit, the Kafa'a source table and the public source. Aggregates under {n} people are suppressed.
defs.uncertainBody: Attrition and hires were read from charts in the 2024 sustainability report; their year mapping is uncertain and they are marked as such.
defs.orgLevel: Organisation-level published value; no small groups.
defs.suppressed: Any group under {n} people is suppressed.
